title: Table
description: Fiori responsive table (ui5-table): selection, popin, growing, row actions, group rows and grid keyboard navigation.

usage.summary: Compose responsive rows and cells when users compare and act on business items.
useWhen: Show several attributes per item and keep related values aligned under column headers.
Compose custom cell controls with TableRow and TableCell; use overflowMode="popin" to move secondary columns below each row on narrow screens.
Enable selectionMode="single" or "multi" for item actions, and use growing="button" or "scroll" with onLoadMore for incremental loading.

avoidWhen.when: Generate columns from data, offer built-in sorting, or render a large row set with virtualization.
Show a few attributes per item without comparing columns.
Choose one value from a short predefined list without showing row details.
Collect fields for editing one object rather than comparing independent items.
